report.summary: Payment confirmations failed due to notification-service encountering deserialization errors starting at 2026-10-20T14:08:00+00:00. This was triggered by the deployment of payments-api v2.16.0 at 14:05, which introduced PaymentCompleted event v3 and renamed the 'amount' field to 'amount_minor'. As notification-service still expected the 'amount' field, it failed to parse the events, causing unhandled exceptions, error rate spikes, and pod restarts.

ranked_hypotheses.title: payments-api v2.16.0 schema change breaks notification-service event deserialization

supporting.note: payments-api v2.16.0 deployed at 14:05 introduced PaymentCompleted event v3 renaming amount to amount_minor, exactly preceding the 14:08 onset.
notification-service error rate spikes right after the deploy at 14:08.
notification-service pod restarts begin at 14:08, matching the onset of the deserialization errors.
Explicitly shows DeserializationError stating PaymentCompleted v3 missing required field 'amount' starting at 14:08:02.
payments-api error rate shows no anomaly, confirming the service itself is healthy post-deployment.
payments-api CPU usage remained stable after deployment.
payments-api memory usage remained stable after deployment.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Third-party SMS vendor outage or push provider failure

contradicting.note: Logs show errors are exclusively DeserializationError for PaymentCompleted v3, with no error logs related to sms-vendor or push-provider.

facts.text: notification-service error rate metric began increasing at 2026-10-20T14:08:00+00:00, reaching a peak of 69.07%.
notification-service pod restarts metric began increasing at 2026-10-20T14:08:00+00:00.
The first DeserializationError log in notification-service occurred at 2026-10-20T14:08:02+00:00 stating PaymentCompleted v3 missing required field 'amount'.
There are no error logs related to sms-vendor or push-provider in notification-service.
notification-service depends asynchronously on event-bus, and synchronously on sms-vendor and push-provider.
There were zero code deployments or config changes for notification-service, sms-vendor, push-provider, event-bus, coredns, or kubernetes over the past 7 days.
payments-api deployed version v2.16.0 at 2026-10-20T14:05:00+00:00, introducing PaymentCompleted event v3 which renames amount to amount_minor.
payments-api error rate shows no anomaly, remaining stable around baseline.
payments-api CPU, memory, request rate, p99 latency, and pod restarts show no anomalies following the deployment.

assumptions: notification-service has not yet been updated to support PaymentCompleted v3 event schema.

timeline.event: payments-api v2.16.0 deployed introducing PaymentCompleted event v3 (amount renamed to amount_minor)
notification-service error rate and pod restarts metrics began increasing
notification-service logs first DeserializationError for PaymentCompleted v3 due to missing 'amount' field
notification-service error rate reaches peak of 69.07%
notification-service pod restarts reaches peak of 2.18 restarts/min

recommended_actions.action: Roll back payments-api to version v2.15.0 or patch notification-service to support PaymentCompleted event v3 schema (handling 'amount_minor').
recommended_actions.rationale: The schema mismatch between payments-api v2.16.0 and notification-service causes continuous deserialization errors and pod restarts.

recommended_actions.action: Implement contract testing or schema validation pipelines between event producers and consumers to prevent breaking changes.
recommended_actions.rationale: Renaming fields in asynchronous domain events without updating downstream consumer schema expectations caused total failure of notification delivery.
